releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Add tips to the manual based on various small questions raised by players 根据群友的各种小问题在手册添加提示 by @TBPig in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5307
* Translations update from AnvilCraft Translate by @Gugle2308 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5069
* Add an automatic check for issues and close the process. 添加 Issue 格式检查自动关闭操作 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5325
* Fix six 1.21 issues: white dwarf colour, chromatic stone quartz, F3 chords, slide duplication, heliostat placement 修复 1.21 的六个问题：白矮星颜色、异彩石石英、F3 组合键、滑轨复制与定日镜放置 by @HHuang19 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5332
* Improve config style and fix bugs about config 提升配置风格并修复配置相关问题 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5316
* Smart Block Placer: correct blueprint placement order and interval, shrink range to blueprint size. 修正智能方块放置器蓝图放置顺序与间隔，并按蓝图尺寸收缩放置范围 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5353
* Revert "Fix six 1.21 issues: white dwarf colour, chromatic stone quartz, F3 chords, slide duplication, heliostat placement 修复 1.21 的六个问题：白矮星颜色、异彩石石英、F3 组合键、滑轨复制与定日镜放置" by @ZhuRuoLing in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5362
* Fix config texts, joke text and remove wrong behavior 修复配置文本、轶事文本并移除错误行为 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5367
* Added a bulk removal function for warehousing. 为仓储添加了批量取出物品的功能 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5364
* style: fix checkstyle violations on dev/1.21/1.6 by @ZhuRuoLing in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5366
* Translations update from AnvilCraft Translate by @Gugle2308 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5383
* Fixed an issue where the structure scanner was unable to update the preview promptly after scanning. 修复了结构扫描仪扫描后无法及时更新预览的问题 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5385
* Added an interface for a container to suck up items from a trough. 添加了溜槽物品吸取容器接口及支持 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5387
* When querying the JEI database for gem recipes, you can directly jump to the gem conversion recipe, which has been modified to include the recipe for the Wither Skelton skull. JEI查询宝石配方时，可以直接跳转至宝石转化配方，修改了凋灵骷髅头颅的配方 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5390
* Modify the audio of supernova explosion and add the audio of the mun's background music.修改超新星爆发音频，新增月球背景音乐音频 by @Lumia-Lumia in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5397
* Split mineral fountain recipes into passive/active/replacement with data-driven heat and fluid output 矿物涌泉配方拆分为被动/主动/替换三类并数据驱动化 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5394
* Fixed an issue where tooltip icons for items visible within the filter were not rendering correctly, and corrected a problem with some models. 让过滤槽位内显示的幽灵物品可以正常渲染tooltip，修正了部分模型 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5404
* Fixed an issue where the buffer charge time was inconsistent in the server environment. Added a configuration file to disable the jump charge function. 修复了服务器环境下缓冲靴蓄力时间异常的问题，添加关闭保持跳跃蓄力的配置文件 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5392
* The issue was identified during multi-block preview, where the rendering direction for blocks facing a specific direction was incorrect. 修复了JEI多方块预览内，带朝向方块渲染方向错误的问题 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5451
* Drop the lead when the corrupted beacon transforms a leashed mob 修复腐化信标转化拴绳生物时丢失拴绳的问题 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5423
* Fix the affect range outline of a working heat collector disappearing too early 修复工作中的集热器范围框过早消失的问题 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5426
* Keep the irradiation target when placing a heliostat from a blueprint 修复建筑杖放置定日镜时丢失照射位置的问题 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5457

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Switch to Anvil Library projection rendering module 改用砧库投影渲染模块 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4993
* Optimize the text and instructions related to architectural supports. 优化建筑杖相关文本和控制说明 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4988
* Add world behavior for cement fluid (source settling + solidify into concrete) 添加水泥流体的世界行为（源头沉降与凝固为混凝土） by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4982
* Update Huoxiang to build.121 and remove duplicate key component registration 更新藿香至 build.121 并移除重复按键组件注册 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5016
* Translations update from AnvilCraft Translate by @Gugle2308 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4935
* Update the manual: cement fluid behavior, amulet list, mineral fountain recipes 更新手册：水泥流体行为、护符大全与矿物涌泉配方 by @TBPig in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5018
* Import extended blueprint recipes, and improve building undo, storage interaction, and rendering compatibility 扩展蓝图配方导入并完善建筑撤销、仓储交互与渲染兼容 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5024
* fix: Improve block rotation and mirroring logic 完善方块旋转和镜像逻辑 by @Hailcrop in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5026
* Refactor Amulet system and support all LivingEntity 重构护符系统并支持所有生物实体 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5042
* Resolve the conflict between the crab claw's grip and the forged star anvil. 修复蟹钳持握姿态与锻星砧的冲突 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5034
* To achieve an infinite atmospheric pressure output capability for the forged star anvil fluid interface. 实现锻星砧流体接口的无穷大气压输出功能 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5045
* Adjust monolith assets and add legacy essence item icon 调整石碑资源并新增 legacy_essence 物品图标 by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5050
* Fix item splitter calculation error and prevent weatherproof helmet from provoking endermen 修复物品分配器份数计算错误及耐候头盔触发末影人仇恨的问题 by @Hailcrop in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5053
* Fix effect blinking and eat effect interception failed 修复效果闪烁与食物效果拦截失效的问题 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5055
* Fix amulet eat-effect interception scope and effect refresh sync 修复护符进食效果拦截范围与所给效果刷新同步 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5057
* Make some amulet-given effects not relative to environment 使部分护符给予的效果不受环境限制 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5059
* Improve pocket slot synchronization in creative mode 改进创造模式口袋槽位同步 by @Hailcrop in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5064
* Improve experience collector absorption logic 优化经验收集器吸取逻辑 by @Hailcrop in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5065
* Fix experience collector to prevent crashes 修复经验收集器导致的崩溃 by @Hailcrop in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5066
* Fix storage bugs: reject unfit items, return recipe bases on merge, JEI transfer under filters 修复仓储系统的相关问题 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5077
* Add civilization catalyst icon and monolith ring model assets 新增文明催化剂图标与石碑环模型资源 by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5072
* Optimize fluid rendering and gas fluid network functionality. 优化流体渲染及气体流体网络功能 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5071
* Restore grain detail in monolith textures 恢复石碑贴图颗粒细节 by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5081
* Update manual, add workstation deformation / 4-to-1 compression recipes and resin pull 更新手册，添加工作站形变与 4 合 1 压缩配方及树脂拉拽 by @TBPig in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5080
* Fix Sophisticated Backpacks terminal recipe transfer 修复精妙背包终端配方填充 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5108
* Fix Mun monolith generation 修复旧存档月球巨石碑生成 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/5106

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Fix crate crafting consuming non-consumable items 修复板条箱合成吞掉不消耗物品的问题 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4846
* adjust gui by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4848
* Add Building Rod 添加建筑杖与蓝图建造功能，完善红石行为、附魔兼容及进度条件 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4854
* Fixed an issue where the game was incorrectly selecting items from the pill or amulet box inventory. 修复了药盒和护符盒选取物品错误的问题 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4853
* add assets of armor by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4857
* Adjust the GUI of SpacetimeSupercomputer, added VFX of laser. 调整了时空超算的GUI，添加了激光特效 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4856
* adjust section textures by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4859
* adjust textures of pockets leggings by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4862
* Added a warehouse GUI flip mode, fixed laser effects, and fixed the selection box for oil cauldron. 添加了仓储gui翻转模式，修复了激光特效，修正了油锅等的选择框 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4865
* Adjust recipes and fix JEI slot style for chance outputs, add material summary for block sequence processing recipes 完成了配方调整，修改了JEI概率产出物品的物品格类型，添加了序列组装配方的材料汇总 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4869
* Fix material list not consuming the book and broken missing-block display in blueprint mode. 修复了智能方块放置器蓝图模式下，材料清单不消耗书，缺失方块显示不正常的问题 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4873
* Add space equipment and inventory pocket system, and improve the building wand and structure scanner, and fixed bugs 添加航天装备与口袋系统并完善建筑杖和结构扫描仪，以及修复bug by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4878
* Rename blackList/whiteList to denyList/allowList 将 blackList/whiteList 统一重命名为 denyList/allowList by @Gu-ZT in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4887
* Fix slot list length desync in the creative inventory screen. 修复创造模式界面槽位列表长度同步问题 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4884
* docs(readme): 修改 README 中的徽标 by @Gu-ZT in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4889
* adjust gui textures of structure scanner, adjust model of CFA item by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4893
* Fixed handle model of celestial forging anvil. 修正了手持锻星砧的物品模型 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4898
* Modify the power mechanism and jump height of the buffer shoe. 修改缓冲靴的蓄力机制和跳跃高度 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4897
* Fixed manual not rendering the processing block, added lighting for the processing block, and fixed laser effects. 修复了手册不渲染进程方块的问题，为进程方块添加了光照，修复了激光特效 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4891
* Fix building wand material handling, equipment abilities and terminal item extraction logic 修复建筑杖材料处理、装备能力与终端取物逻辑 by @WhereisFff in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4901
* Redraw structure scanner redo/stop button textures 重绘结构扫描仪 redo/stop 按钮贴图 by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4903
* Fixe the bug that bufferboots can not keep its charge. 修复了缓冲靴蓄力无法保持的问题 by @PigeonNian in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4905
* Refactor Frost smithing and update tooltip 重构浮霜锻造与更新tooltip by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4852
* Complete dependency relationships 补全依赖关系 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4908
* Adjust HD storage port textures 调整高密度存储端口贴图 by @XeKr in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4910
* Refactor amulet system to more registry driven 重构护符系统并使其更加注册表驱动 by @QiuShui1012 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4909
* Translations update from AnvilCraft Translate by @Gugle2308 in https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilCraft/pull/4850
